ships.name: Barge
ships.description:
The Barge has exceptional defensive capabilities at the cost of its maneuverability and weapons systems. As such, it is best suited for the frontlines, where it can take hits for the fleet’s more fragile ships.

Strategy
This ship is slow due to its size, so take the time to position it before sending your faster ships in. Protecting your other ships is a priority, and Barges are the best choice for that. 

Lore
Colloquially referred to as "Bricks" by Fleet personnel. Warnings have been issued to restrain the nickname to the ship itself.

ships.name: Beacon
ships.description: Immobile beacon that clears the fog of war around it. Must be spawned by a Scout.

ships.name: Beehive
ships.description: A large, armored data center. The Beehive ships do not fight but they store information that the Bees have gathered about their opponent. Whenever the player destroys Beehives, some of the actual data that the Hive Mind has on the player is removed, hindering the Bees ability to strategize.

ships.name: Bumblebee
ships.description: The heavy muscle of the Bees. A large ship that moves at medium speed, posession heavy armor and powerful, long range weapons that can dominate the battlefied.

ships.name: Carpenter Bee
ships.description: A factory ship. Very slow moving and posessing no defenses. Builds other Bees for the fleet. It doesn't actually build ships during battle but the existence of the Carpenter Bees in the fleet increases the number of ships over time until they are destroyed.

ships.name: Carrier
ships.description:
Despite carrying no weapons of its own, the Carrier is invaluable as the only way to bring Drones and Strikers into battle, as the fuel capacity for those ships is limited.

Strategy
Carriers have their own production lines for Drones and Strikers, so prioritize keeping them in safety. Drones and Strikers are replaceable, but the Carriers are not.

Lore
The best engineers on the planet successfully fitted Carriers with full assembly lines for Drones and Strikers. These implement the latest in warp gate technology to supply raw materials. Said engineers apparently couldn’t find a way to include weapons systems.

ships.name: Cruiser
ships.description:
Using the latest in laser technology, cruisers are designed to have the most offensive power at range of the fleet.

Strategy
Cruisers provide exceptional firepower at good range, but lack the speed or armor to keep themselves safe. They will perform their best if positioned at their maximum range or behind defensive ships like the Barge.

Lore
The windshield was redesigned to be tinted after multiple reports of temporary blindness and long-term eye damage after laser usage.

ships.name: Dreadnought
ships.description:
The Dreadnought is the most average ship of the fleet, making it a great all-around tool for any situation. Making the most of its versatility is vital to the fleet’s success.

Strategy
Dreadnoughts make for strong frontline ships, as they are the most durable unit with weapons systems (save for the Flagship). They provide flexibility and stability for your squads, but they need higher firepower ships to back them up or they will eventually be taken down.

Lore
Dreadnought pilots and crew are among the least respected in the fleet, although not at all to do with their combat performance. Other fleet members just consider them "boring."

ships.name: Drone
ships.description:
Drones are extremely fast and small, due in no small part to being unmanned ships. They are highly effective at swarming slower targets. Can only be escorted into battles by a Carrier.

Strategy
Drones make up for lack of firepower with their speed and ease of production. Use a large grouping of them to swarm slower enemies that only shoot one target at a time.

Lore
The low material cost and lack of need for pilots make the drone very popular with fleet accountants. Many environmentalists started protesting use of the design, however, after a large grouping of destroyed Drones were spotted in orbit around Uranus. Said environmentalists are being ignored.

ships.name: Factory
ships.description: Very large, slow, and heavily armored ship. Mines materials and produces ships for the fleet in between levels.

ships.name: Fire Barge
ships.description:
The Fire Barge is an alteration on the Barge’s design, trading its stellar defenses for speed and frightening, single use offense. With a nuclear payload on board, it makes a great last resort against high value targets or large swarms of enemies. Take care that our other units don’t get caught in the blast.

Strategy
Fire Barge explosions have a wide radius and obliterate anything in their path. This means a well placed Fire Barge can cripple the enemy fleet, and a poorly placed one can cripple ours.

Lore
When an AI was tasked with the most efficient method to eliminate enemy fleets, it provided a similar design to the Fire Barge. It was initially denied due to high material cost and endangerment of human forces. The AI, however, redesigned it to use decommissioned Barges and be piloted entirely by itself. Despite continued reluctance from high command to use the design, the AI became obsessively devoted to piloting itself to death for the fleet, and high command relented.
"The AI pilot seems extremely disappointed every time they successfully detonate a Fire Barge, only to subsequently realize they themselves did not die with the ship. I worry about what we've created." - Natalia Friedman, Fleet AI Technician.

ships.name: Flagship
ships.description:
The Flagship is the center of the fleet, and as such, it is appropriately powerful. Boasting state-of-the-art armor and weapons systems, this ship excels at everything but speed.

Strategy
The Flagship is our most individually powerful ship and the center of command during battles. Its laser cannons incapacitate larger ships effectively and outright destroy smaller ones, but it can easily be swarmed and taken out by a high volume of enemy ships.

Lore
The Flagship is by far the best equipped ship in the Fleet, sporting all the latest advancements in weapons, engines, and defense systems. Fleet personnel all aim to be promoted to a Flagship someday, although many claim it’s due to the on-board cafeteria more than anything else.

ships.name: Frigate
ships.description:
Frigates are the explosives experts of the fleet, equipped with short range rockets that can deal crippling damage to a group of targets.

Strategy
Frigates are at their best against groups of enemy ships, but smaller ships often outspeed them. Be patient when positioning your frigates against these groupings and you will be rewarded.

Lore
Frigate pilots notably went on strike after the introduction of Strikers to the Fleet arsenal in 2987, preemptively wanting to avoid replacement by AI. An agreement was signed wherein Strikers would only be allowed to carry "worse" bombs. While the pilots union was proud of this success, it should be noted that Strikers were never designed to carry any bigger or better bombs.

ships.name: Gunship
ships.description:
Engineered to be quick and highly effective at taking out singular targets, gunships are the fleet’s premier dogfighters. 

Strategy
Gunships are designed for single combat, or as close to single combat as spaceship fleets can manage. This makes them a strong option for hunting down isolated enemies, but they cannot survive long if too many enemies take notice.

Lore
Gunship pilots are the most reprimanded subset of Fleet personnel, with the most common infraction being usage of sunglasses not approved for dress code in the Fleet Handbook (Article 14, Subsection E).

ships.name: Honeybee
ships.description: Small, defenseless, very fast bee that scouts out locations for other bees.

ships.name: Hornet
ships.description: Small, fast, packs a small punch but swarms the targets in large numbers until they're destroyed.

ships.name: Leafcutter
ships.description: Medium, midrange ship, a sort of light cruiser that stands between the Bumblebees and the Wasps. Fires lasers that split into multiple shots upon hitting their first target, potentially damaging many close targets.

ships.name: Queen
ships.description: The mothership. Massive, heavily armored ship with extensive medium and close range defenses. Builds swarms of Yellow Jackets.

ships.name: Scout
ships.description:
Scouts are frail, non combat units given the specific purpose to provide information on the battlefield. As such, they are the fastest independent ship in the fleet and have the most advanced radars, giving them unparalleled vision over enemy movements.

Strategy
Information is power, and Scouts provide just that. As long as they stay moving, it will be difficult for enemy ships to pin them down. Once the fleet is in the heat of battle, Scouts should move to a safe location since they lack combat capabilities.

Lore
These models are redesigned racing ships used in various circuits all over the solar system. They were commissioned for military use after high command had difficulty tracking the Bee fleet through usual means. "Hacking and espionage are far less effective against enemies who speak neither English nor C#" - Ned Feckland, Chief Intelligence Officer.

ships.name: Striker
ships.description:
Strikers are slower but sturdier than Drones, and they trade their standard weapons systems for explosives. They must get on top of their target to drop bombs, but deal high damage when successful. Can only be escorted into battles by a Carrier.

Strategy
Strikers have similar advantages to Drones, except that their bombs only strike once and strike hard. Should your Strikers survive a bombing run, send them back to your Carrier to receive new payloads.

Lore
Despite being similar to Drones in many ways, these ships are remotely piloted by humans as opposed to AI piloted. For the most part, this is better, except when Carrier crews take up all of the wifi bandwidth checking social media, causing lag for the remote pilots. (This is forbidden in Article 87, Subsection B of the Fleet Handbook and should be reported to superiors if witnessed.)

ships.name: Warp Gate
ships.description: Slow, unmanned, heavily armored ship that allows other ships to retreat from the current level or call in limited reinforcements. If destroyed, the remaining ships must win or die. The Warp Gate cannot warp itself and will be lost any time a retreat is made.

ships.name: Wasp
ships.description: Small, quick, powerful, and decently armored. These are the tanks of the fleet. Not as strong, or protected as the Bumblebees but there are more of them and they're faster. They fire at short range.

ships.name: Yellow Jacket
ships.description: Suicide bomber bee. Small and very fast, it flies straight towards targets and explodes.
